milestone: MOGO-004 M1 -- Evidence Expansion & Research Governance

statusDefinitions.UNSUPPORTED: No evidence supports this hypothesis: either MOGO does not implement the rule, or the rule is MOGO-authored with no educator support, or no observation exists.
statusDefinitions.COLLECTING: Evidence exists and is accumulating, but the minimum operational sample has not been reached in both comparison arms.
statusDefinitions.SUPPORTED: Minimum sample reached in both arms, predeclared metric measured, comparison completed, and the promotion threshold satisfied.
statusDefinitions.REJECTED: Minimum sample reached in both arms and the rejection threshold satisfied.
statusDefinitions.UNRESOLVED: The hypothesis cannot be resolved by the evidence class available -- for example a live-execution-only rule that no replay can ever exercise.

promotionThreshold.supportedWhen: armA expectancy exceeds armB expectancy by >= 0.25R with the confidence interval excluding zero
promotionThreshold.rejectedWhen: the difference is < 0.25R, or favours armB, with both arms at or above the minimum operational sample

sampleBasis: Both figures are DECLARED IN ADVANCE, not derived from observed results. At 30 resolved trades per arm a 0.25R expectancy difference remains within sampling noise for a 2R/-1R system; 100 per arm is where it becomes reliably resolvable. Stating them up front is what stops either being rationalised downward after a result.

MET_PROFIT_FACTOR.name: Profit factor
MET_PROFIT_FACTOR.formula: gross positive R / abs(gross negative R)
